58481
The additional progressive taxes for the crop years 1953-
1954 and 1954-1955 are also waived for the Central Santos
Lopez Co., Inc., provided that the planters' participation
shall be increased as follows until the planters' participa-
tion will have reached 60 per cent effective the crop year
1957-1958 as provided for in the 10-year contract between
the central and the planters:
56 per cent for the crop year 1954-1955;
5; per cent for the crop year 1955-1956;
58½ per cent for the crop year 1956-1957; and
60 per cent effective the crop year 1957-1958.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-five,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the tenth.
RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARIANO YENKO, JR.
Assistant Executive Secretary
